tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: ONE full-body single pose of the exact Hamilton Turtle adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 PRESENT_LEFT: Indicate viewer LEFT with gaze and a connected existing forelimb/wing/fin; clearly leftward teaching gesture, both feet supported where present. Species constraints: 海亀の遊泳フリッパーへ変えない。顔を殻内へ消したり頭の大きさを縮めたりせず、甲羅の斑・腹板を維持する。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. Critical hand design: the extended forelimb must be the exact short rounded mitten-like turtle paw already in image1, ending in THREE tiny cream claw marks. No palm fingers, no separate thumb, no human five-finger hand. Indicate clearly to viewer LEFT while retaining the rightmost other forelimb at rest.
